texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the accused-applicant submits that there is no reliable and legally acceptable evidence to hold accused- applicant guilty for the alleged offence(s) and there is every likelihood of succeeding in the criminal revision petition. Learned counsel further submits that final hearing of the petition is likely to take time thus sentence of the accused-applicant may be suspended. Learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the prayer regarding suspension of sentence. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant submits that accused-applicant was on bail during trial as well as during pendency of appeal and presently he is behind the bars.
